dates.name: Donut Falls Hike — Big Cottonwood Canyon Waterfall
dates.desc: Easy spring hike to a stunning donut-shaped waterfall. Only 1.5-2 hours, perfect for a quick outdoor adventure. The waterfall is iconic and the hike is manageable with beautiful canyon views. Park at Jordan Pines for the shorter 1.5-mile route. Fresh mountain air and easy accomplishment.
dates.where: Donut Falls Trailhead — Big Cottonwood Canyon Rd, Salt Lake City, UT (25 miles from downtown SLC)

dates.name: Thanksgiving Point Tulip Festival — Spring Blooms Peak Season
dates.desc: Peak tulip season! Over 1 million flowers across 50 acres of Ashton Gardens in full vibrant bloom. Stroll through stunning garden pathways, snap photos among towering rows of color, and soak in the mountain views. Weekday mornings are less crowded. Bring a camera for incredible photos.
dates.where: Thanksgiving Point Ashton Gardens — 3900 N. Garden Drive, Lehi, UT 84048

dates.name: Provo Canyon Scenic Loop — Hiking & Waterfall Exploration
dates.desc: Combine a scenic drive through Provo Canyon (US-189) with a short hike to Bridal Veil Falls. The falls plunge 600 feet down sheer cliffs — otherworldly views. Easy 1.3-mile paved trail to the base. Stop at scenic pullouts along the drive. Perfect for a spring afternoon adventure with minimal effort, maximum impact.
dates.where: Bridal Veil Falls — Highway 189, Provo Canyon, UT (25 min from Lehi/30 min from Salt Lake City)

dates.name: Dinner at Courchevel Bistro — French Fine Dining in Park City
dates.desc: Intimate French bistro on Park City's historic Main Street with classic French cuisine and expert wine pairings. Standout dishes: Venison Loin Medallion, Steak Frites, and baked brie. Romantic ambiance, attentive service, and a charming location perfect for a special evening. Reservations essential.
dates.where: Courchevel Bistro — Park City Main Street, Park City, UT

dates.name: Antelope Island State Park — Wildflower & Wildlife Adventure
dates.desc: Peak wildflower season with spring blooms covering the island. Drive the scenic loop to spot native bison herds, pronghorn antelope, bighorn sheep, and mule deer. Stop at scenic overlooks for Great Salt Lake views. Picnic with wildlife nearby. May offers the best wildflower colors and active wildlife. Stunning photo ops everywhere.
dates.where: Antelope Island State Park — 4528 W 1700 S, Syracuse, UT 84075 (30 min north of Salt Lake City)

dates.name: Escape Room at Mystery Escape Room — Downtown Salt Lake City
dates.desc: 60 minutes of immersive puzzle-solving in themed rooms at the Gateway. Multiple difficulty levels: test your teamwork, communication, and problem-solving skills under pressure. You loved Getout Games; this is Utah's original live escape room with a great reputation. Perfect for a Friday afternoon challenge before dinner.
dates.where: Mystery Escape Room — 111 S 400 W (The Gateway), Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Trappers Lake Trail — Little Cottonwood Canyon
dates.desc: Moderate 3.5-mile hike to a pristine alpine lake surrounded by wildflowers and mountain peaks. Spring runoff creates flowing streams and cascades. Less crowded than Donut Falls with equally stunning scenery. Great for photography and exploring pristine mountain terrain.
dates.where: Trappers Lake Trailhead — Little Cottonwood Canyon Rd, UT (~25 miles from SLC)

dates.name: Ghost Falls Trail — Provo Canyon Hidden Gem
dates.desc: Short but rewarding hike to a hidden waterfall in Provo Canyon. Less known than Bridal Veil, so fewer crowds. Moderate difficulty with beautiful canyon views and seasonal wildflowers. Great for a quick spring adventure with big payoff. Perfect companion hike to pair with canyon drive.
dates.where: Ghost Falls Trailhead — Provo Canyon, UT (30 min from Lehi)

dates.name: Snowbird Aerial Tram — High Alpine Scenic Experience
dates.desc: Ride the aerial tram 2,000 vertical feet to Hidden Peak (11,000 ft) for 360-degree views of the Wasatch Mountains and beyond. Accessible through May. Walk scenic trails, visit the summit restaurant, or simply breathe alpine air. No skiing required—just stunning vistas.
dates.where: Snowbird Resort — 9385 E Snowbird Tram Rd, Snowbird, UT 84092

dates.name: Log Haven — Rustic Mountain Dining in Mill Creek Canyon
dates.desc: Tucked four miles up scenic Mill Creek Canyon, Log Haven offers Chef Dave Jones' menu featuring Southwestern spice and mountain-inspired cuisine. Rustic cabin setting with fireplace, creek views, and intimate ambiance. Farm-fresh seasonal ingredients. Reservations required.
dates.where: Log Haven — Mill Creek Canyon Road, Salt Lake City, UT (20 min from downtown)

dates.name: Handle — Farm-to-Table Restaurant in Park City
dates.desc: Celebrated farm-to-table restaurant featuring small plates and creative entrees. Standouts: sweet chili-glazed cauliflower and house-made pasta. Locally sourced ingredients with a modern, vibrant atmosphere on Park City's Main Street. Upscale casual vibe perfect for a spring dinner.
dates.where: Handle — Park City Main Street, Park City, UT 84060

dates.name: Yuki Yama Sushi — Premium Fresh Sushi in Park City
dates.price: $80 - $130 for two (omakase or à la carte)
dates.desc: Park City's best sushi with daily fresh fish flown in. Expert chefs prepare nigiri, rolls, and specials with precision. Intimate counter seating or cozy tables. Reservations available up to 60 days ahead. Perfect for a special sushi date with maximum quality.
dates.where: Yuki Yama Sushi — Park City Main Street, Park City, UT

dates.name: Clark Planetarium + The Gateway District Stroll
dates.desc: Free interactive science museum with immersive space exhibits and full-dome IMAX theater. Then stroll The Gateway district for dessert, shopping, art installations, or an arcade bar. Easy afternoon with lots of options.
dates.where: Clark Planetarium — 110 S 400 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Park City Historic Main Street — Explore & Dine
dates.desc: Walkable historic district lined with galleries, shops, and restaurants. Grab coffee at a local café, browse art galleries, and choose from diverse dining options. Live music often plays on weekends. Perfect for a relaxed spring stroll with dining flexibility.
dates.where: Park City Historic Main Street — Park City, UT (various restaurants/galleries)

dates.name: Mirror Lake Scenic Byway — High Alpine Drive & Hiking
dates.desc: Utah's highest paved road at 10,715 feet. 42-mile scenic drive with multiple pullouts, photo ops, and short hikes. Opens late May (check conditions). Stunning panoramic views, mountain wildflowers, and pristine alpine lakes. Bring layers—cool at elevation. One-of-a-kind experience.
dates.where: Mirror Lake Scenic Byway — State Route 150, Kamas to Duck Creek (1 hour from Park City)

dates.name: TopGolf at Vineyard — Gamified Golf Experience
dates.desc: Gamified golf bays with automatic scoring, full food menu, and zero golf skill required. Fun, competitive energy with lively bar scene. Bay pricing is per bay, not per person—great value for two. Play games, grab food, enjoy the vibe.
dates.where: TopGolf — 484 N Entertainment Way, Vineyard, UT 84059

dates.name: Escape Room at Getout Games — Salt Lake City
dates.desc: Four themed rooms downtown: Egyptian Tomb, Zombie on a Chain, The Heist, or Reactor Room. 60 minutes of puzzle-solving and teamwork under pressure. You loved this before—book in advance. Great for testing your problem-solving chemistry.
dates.where: Getout Games — 202 W 400 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Firewood — Wood-Fired Cuisine in Park City
dates.desc: Bold, innovative cooking style with everything cooked over wood fire using locally sourced ingredients. Atmospheric open kitchen, craft cocktails, and extensive wine list. Upscale-casual vibe with stunning presentation. Reservations recommended. Unique dining experience.
dates.where: Firewood — Park City, UT (check visitparkcity.com for current location)
